versions.name: Mining in Society
versions.description: Match ten minerals to the products they end up in, map working mines, examine the gear and monitoring that keeps miners safe underground, and weigh reclamation, recycling, and the case for mining asteroids.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
